definitions.explanation: capable of being used for many different purposes
having unlimited power or ability, especially referring to deities

examples.japanese: この{万能|ばんのう}ナイフは{便利|べんり}だ。
{万能|ばんのう}ネギは{様々|さまざま}な{料理|りょうり}に{使|つか}える。
examples.english: Green onions can be used in various dishes.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{万能|ばんのう}{選手|せんしゅ}だ。
{万能|ばんのう}の{神|かみ}を{信|しん}じる。
examples.english: To believe in an almighty god.

examples.japanese: {金|かね}は{万能|ばんのう}ではない。
{科学|かがく}を{万能|ばんのう}と{考|かんが}えるのは{間違|まちが}いだ。
examples.english: It's wrong to think science is omnipotent.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {万能|ばんのう}ナイフ - Swiss army knife, all-purpose knife
- {万能|ばんのう}ネギ - green onion (lit. 'all-purpose onion')
- {万能|ばんのう}{選手|せんしゅ} - all-around player/athlete
- {万能|ばんのう}{調味料|ちょうみりょう} - all-purpose seasoning
- {万能|ばんのう}の{神|かみ} - almighty God

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {万能|ばんのう}{薬|やく} - cure-all, panacea
- {万能|ばんのう}{型|がた} - universal type
- {万能|ばんのう}{感|かん} - feeling of omnipotence

CONTRAST:
- {専用|せんよう} - exclusive use, dedicated
